seo.title: Stance Health Academies
seo.description: Athlete assessments, field programs, and rehab for sports academies and players in Bengaluru.

props.heading: Let's Get Your Athletes Assessed
props.description: Tell us who you are and we'll get back with a plan tailored to your sport and squad.
props.note: We use your details only to contact you about Stance Health Academies.

props.heading: One System. Four Ways to Train.
props.description: Whether it's one athlete or a full squad, everything starts with data and ends with performance.

cards.title: In-Centre Assessment
cards.description: Know the body before you train it. MSK screening plus VALD ForceFrame and ForceDeck testing reveal strength, asymmetries and readiness.

cards.title: On-Field Assessment
cards.description: Testing where the sport is played. Speed, endurance, change of direction and agility tests show how they work together in real conditions.

cards.title: Performance Programs
cards.description: Individualised rehab and performance plans, delivered in-centre, with teams or on-field. Team modules for academies, 1-on-1 for athletes.

cards.title: Summer Camps
cards.description: On-field camps with individual assessment reports, covering strength, speed, agility, plyometrics and conditioning. Customisable to your sport.

props.heading: Every Athlete Gets a Performance Report
props.description: No guesswork. Every metric is measured, explained and turned into a plan you can act on.

faqs.question: What exactly does Stance do for academies?
faqs.answer: We assess your athletes with sport-specific testing, then deliver structured field programs, rehab support and summer camps based on the results.

faqs.question: Which sports do you work with?
faqs.answer: Cricket, football, swimming, athletics, tennis, combat sports, endurance and more. Programs are customised to the demands of each sport.

faqs.question: How does an assessment help prevent injuries?
faqs.answer: Our assessments check strength, asymmetries and movement efficiency, which can flag risk areas before they become injuries. Your report shows what to train and what to protect.

faqs.question: What age groups can enroll?
faqs.answer: We work with junior and adult athletes. The exact assessment format is tailored to age, training history and sport.

faqs.question: How do I know I'm ready to return to play after an injury?
faqs.answer: Readiness should be based on measurable data, not just how you feel. We test strength, force production and movement quality, then compare to sport-specific benchmarks.

faqs.question: Can you come to our academy for assessments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We deliver field-based programs and on-field assessments at your ground, as well as at our centres.

faqs.question: Is a summer camp only for cricket?
faqs.answer: No. The structure shown is our cricket format, and it can be fully customised to your sport and requirements.

faqs.question: What types of sports injuries can Stance help treat?
faqs.answer: Stance treats ACL injuries, meniscus tears, runner's knee, ankle sprains, Achilles tendinopathy, shin splints, plantar fasciitis, rotator cuff issues, and other common sports injuries.

props.heading: Know where you stand. Then get stronger, faster and more resilient.
